g.text: The Issuing Provider registers the Issuer with the TAS,
and once the TAS administrator approves it (ACTIVE), the Issuer is exposed in the wallet's Issuer list.
P232-3 : Enter Claims and Create Credential Offer
The wallet performs P230-2 (Retrieve Credential Offer) ~ P230-6 (Request Credential) (Token is requested without a tx_code)
